instruction: Create /workspace/fizzbuzz.py. Running `python3 fizzbuzz.py N` must print the numbers 1 to N, one per line, but print Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5 and FizzBuzz for multiples of both. Test it, then submit.
check: python3 fizzbuzz.py 15 | tr -d ' ' | paste -sd, - | grep -qx '1,2,Fizz,4,Buzz,Fizz,7,8,Fizz,Buzz,11,Fizz,13,14,FizzBuzz' && python3 fizzbuzz.py 1 | grep -qx 1
